title: Stella McCartney designs Beatles t-shirts for Red Nose Day 2009
content:
Stella McCartney has designed a range of t-shirts for Comic Relief’s Red Nose Day 2009.

The designs include a picture of The Beatles wearing red noses, in addition to a David Bailey portrait of Morecambe and Wise.

The Beatles t-shirt is adapted from a famous photograph of the group taken by Linda McCartney at the Sgt Pepper launch, which took place at Brian Epstein’s house on 19 May 1967.

Red Nose Day takes place on 13 March 2009. At least £5 of the bargain £9.99 price goes to Comic Relief, a thoroughly good cause which the Beatles Bible is happy to endorse.

Page last updated: 2 June 2020
